brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
I don’t think anybody has tried to use it, but I had @buildthis.bisks.net make a quick atproto p2p lunchclub style app. didn’t put a lot of thought or effort into it but lmk if you’ve got any suggestions

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@hyl.st: Same btw :) I also live in Seattle and love meeting internet friends, let's hang out
  [quoting @goose.art: anyone i am mutuals with on here who lives in seattle is welcome to ask to hang out anytime btw

i love meeting internet friends]
(attached to the post that tagged the bot)
  [link: https://postwith.bisks.net/ — postwith — an atproto matchmaker — Lunchclub-style, peer-to-peer: post what you're into and what you want out of it, get matched by topic, propose a meeting, log the outcome.]
note: postwith could only match by topic before, which is no good if the point is meeting up in person — added an optional city field, and matches near you now float to the top.
